data.name: Van Tich Legends
data.detailed_description:
Vạn Tích Legends drops you into a world where Vietnamese legends no longer live on the page, they erupt right before your eyes through every strike, every battle, and every culturally rich environment.

This is a fast-paced 3D beat ’em up action game where you can fight solo or team up with friends in co-op, facing increasingly relentless waves of enemies. Every encounter isn’t just about fighting, it’s about skill expression, reflexes, and coordination.

Choose to embody legendary figures like Thánh Gióng, wielding overwhelming power, Sơn Tinh, master of the land and mountains, or Thủy Tinh, unleashing the fury of water. Each character brings a distinct combat style, offering completely different gameplay experiences.

Explore vividly recreated Vietnamese rural maps in 3D from bamboo bridges stretching over quiet ponds, thatched houses tucked beneath shady trees, golden haystacks in sunlit yards, and rice fields swaying in the wind, to charcoal stoves softly smoking at dusk. These are no longer peaceful memories, they are your battlegrounds.

🔥 Key Features:

  • ⚔️ Fast-paced, hard-hitting 3D beat ’em up combat.

  • 🧩 Diverse skill systems for each legendary character.

  • 💥 Creative combo mechanics, chain abilities into satisfying attack sequences.

  • 🤝 Flexible co-op, team up and unleash powerful combo plays together.

  • 🏞️ Unique Vietnamese countryside settings, rich in cultural identity.

Vạn Tích Legends isn’t just an action game—it’s where you rewrite familiar tales in a way that’s more intense, more epic, and more personal than ever before.

Don’t just retell the legends, experience them yourself!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
